summary: Frontend-only regression on merged Thread Pro (Expo web preview at 375x667). All 11 flows in the review request PASSED end-to-end: home renders 6 cards + gear (THREAD SPECS + SHOP TOOLS), Drill Tip Calculator computes 0.0751 in for D=0.25/A=118 and result correctly resets on unit toggle, Unified/Metric spec screens (EXTERNAL/INTERNAL toggle, class chips 2A/3A for external, tap-drill-result + percent-75 + tap-cutting/tap-forming for internal, three-wire-result + wire-input for external), Pipe selector navigates NPT->npt-tap-drill and BSPP->bsp-tap-drill, Drills list has all filter chips (ALL/Fractional/Wire/Letter/Metric), search-mode in/mm and drills-search (search '1/4' filters to 2 rows), drill detail shows drill-title-block + diameter cards, Tap Chart forming mode correctly hides taps-section-npt while keeping unified/metric visible, Settings has 5 theme presets + 8 accent swatches + 5 custom color hex inputs + reset-colors; custom hex #00AAFF applied live and persisted on return to home. Back navigation works on every sub-screen. No red screen errors, no page errors, no deprecated Expo packages detected in package.json.
critical_code_review_comments: On web, Expo Router keeps prior screens mounted in the DOM (multiple stacked routes visible via testID lookup). Not a bug but worth knowing: selectors like [data-testid=back-btn] resolve to multiple nodes; the visible one is the topmost stack entry. This is expected for Stack navigator on web and does not affect native.
app/_layout.tsx: LogBox.ignoreAllLogs(true) suppresses ALL warnings which can hide real issues during development. Consider gating behind __DEV__ off or removing before release.
app/index.tsx uses fixed brand font size 30 with letterSpacing 3; on very narrow devices this may overflow but was fine at 375px width.
seed_data_creation: None. App is fully offline with bundled JSON.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All flows in review request verified working. When writing Playwright for Expo web, use `[data-testid="..."]:visible` and `.last` to target the topmost stacked screen, because prior routes remain in the DOM tree. Mobile viewport 375x667. Preview URL from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL/EXPO_PACKAGER_PROXY_URL.
